fact: OpenCRVS says its production-level Unified Digital Civil Registration System operates in 30 Somali districts, is linked to 160 hospitals and has completed 28,391 birth registrations.

fact: Ecofin Agency reports the Ministry of Interior, Federal Affairs and Reconciliation piloted a Unified Digital Civil Registration Service in 19 districts on 10 August 2025, with national rollout planned in phases.
Ecofin Agency says the pilot platform enables local administrations to digitally register births, marriages, divorces and deaths, stored in a central national database.
Hiiraan Online reports Somalia is rolling out a Civil Registration Management and Vital Statistics System (CRMVS) delivered in November with NADRA support and managed by NIRA.

fact: NADRA says a Civil Registration Management and Vital Statistics System (CRMVS) was built and handed over to Somali authorities in November 2024, and Somalia is preparing to launch it as part of the SNID project.
